tagline: Leading technology distributor of electronic components and enterprise computing solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Represents 70% of the company's consolidated sales in 2025 and reflects the core strategy of distributing electronic components to OEMs and EMS providers through more than 140 sales centers and 39 distribution centers.

kpis.name: Global Components Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the sale of electronic components to OEMs and EMS providers
kpis.description: Revenue from the Global Components segment for fiscal year 2025, representing approximately 70% of the company's total consolidated sales

kpis.name: Global ECS Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the sale of enterprise computing solutions and services to VARs and MSPs
kpis.description: Revenue from the Global ECS segment for fiscal year 2025, representing approximately 30% of total consolidated sales. This segment delivers comprehensive IT solutions, cloud services, and management platforms to value-added resellers and managed service providers

kpis.name: Consolidated Sales
kpis.explanation: Total consolidated revenue of the company
kpis.description: Total consolidated revenue for fiscal year 2025, derived from the two reportable segments: Global Components and Global ECS

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin for fiscal year 2025, down 60 basis points compared to 2024 (11.8%), partly due to losses on certain contracts with non-cancellable purchase obligations

kpis.name: Operating Income Margin
kpis.description: Consolidated operating income margin for fiscal year 2025, down 10 basis points compared to 2024 (2.8%)

kpis.name: Net Income Attributable to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Consolidated net income attributable to shareholders
kpis.description: Net income attributable to shareholders for fiscal year 2025, up significantly by 45.7% compared to 2024 ($392 million)

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.explanation: Diluted earnings per share attributable to shareholders
kpis.description: Diluted earnings per share for fiscal year 2025, up 49.9% compared to 2024 ($7.29)

kpis.name: ArrowSphere Cloud Growth
kpis.explanation: Expansion of cloud-based computing solutions through the ArrowSphere management platform for VARs and MSPs
kpis.description: ArrowSphere is Arrow's cloud management platform and marketplace that helps value-added resellers and managed service providers manage, differentiate, and grow their cloud businesses. The platform includes an AI-enabled digital go-to-market system to help channel partners sell and support various cloud offerings.

kpis.name: IPE Market Penetration
kpis.explanation: Strategy to increase market penetration for IPE components that generate higher margins
kpis.description: One of Global Components' key strategic initiatives is to increase penetration in the IP and Edge components market, which tends to be a higher-margin segment of the broader available market, supporting longer and more profitable relationships with suppliers and customers.

risks.title: Global and regional economic weakness
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly exposed to global and regional economic conditions. The registration statement explicitly states that economic weakness and uncertainty could have a material adverse effect on financial performance, including net revenues, gross margins, earnings, and cash flows.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Arrow is subject to various complex laws and regulations, including commercial, export, antitrust, and anti-corruption laws. Regulatory changes, particularly related to government contractors and AI, could have a material adverse impact.

risks.title: Dependence on key supplier relationships
risks.score_rationale: Arrow relies heavily on relationships with technology suppliers and its non-cancellable contractual obligations. Changes in these relationships or failure to achieve sales could significantly impact financial results.

risks.title: Increased competition and margin pressure
risks.score_rationale: The technology distribution and IT solutions industry is highly competitive. Arrow faces increased pressure on profit margins and the need to innovate in value-added services.

risks.title: Supply chain and product availability risks
risks.score_rationale: Arrow is exposed to risks of supply chain disruptions, shortages, and inefficiencies, including the impacts of trade tariffs and geopolitical conflicts, which could affect product availability and pricing.

risks.title: Technology and digital transformation risks
risks.score_rationale: Arrow must continuously adapt its technology platform and solutions to remain competitive. Failure to keep pace with technological developments, particularly in cloud and AI, could reduce its competitive appeal.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection risks
risks.score_rationale: Arrow manages sensitive information from suppliers and customers. Failures, disruptions, or breaches of information systems, including those of third-party providers, could result in financial losses and loss of trust.

risks.title: Management transition risks
risks.score_rationale: Arrow is currently in the process of recruiting a permanent CEO following management transitions. Management uncertainty could affect strategic continuity and performance.

ai_positioning.summary: Arrow Electronics is gradually integrating AI capabilities into its solutions and platforms. The ArrowSphere platform includes an AI-enabled digital go-to-market platform to help channel partners sell cloud offerings, although AI is not positioned as a dominant strategic driver.
evidence: ArrowSphere includes an AI-enabled digital go-to-market platform aimed at helping the company's channel partners sell and support a variety of cloud offerings at higher rates
